### Landman (2024) — Money, Influence & The Ruthless Oil Game 🛢️

Landman is a drama series starring Billy Bob Thornton as Tommy Norris, a seasoned crisis manager working in the high-pressure oil industry of West Texas. Surrounded by wealthy executives, hardworking oil-field crews, and dangerous business interests, Tommy is responsible for keeping operations running while handling problems that can quickly spiral out of control.

As the stakes rise, Tommy finds himself dealing with deadly accidents, criminal threats, corporate power struggles, and family complications. Every deal brings new risks, and every decision can affect millions of dollars. In an industry where ambition drives people to their limits, Tommy must rely on his instincts and experience to stay ahead of trouble.

The series explores greed, ambition, loyalty, family, and the consequences of chasing power. It reveals how the pursuit of wealth can change people's priorities and force them to make difficult choices when business and personal life collide.

What makes Landman compelling is its raw portrayal of the oil business and the people who keep it running. Behind the money and influence lies a dangerous game where trust is fragile, pressure never disappears, and one mistake can cost everything.

💬 “Everyone wants a share of the fortune, but only a few understand the risks behind it.”

source_details.synopsis: Landman is an American drama series created by Taylor Sheridan and Christian Wallace, inspired by the podcast series Boomtown hosted by Wallace. Starring Billy Bob Thornton as a landman for an oil company, the show premiered on November 17, 2024, on Paramount+. In March 2025, the series was renewed for a second season, which premiered on November 16, 2025. In December 2025, the series was renewed for a third season. Despite some elements igniting controversy, the series has been received positively by critics overall.
